observed_shift_evidence.deduplication: Resends and same-date assignment changes were counted once.
observed_shift_evidence.limitation: Observed shift notices are not a payslip and do not verify allowances, deductions, payment, or a future accepted schedule.

sustainable_target.safety_rule: Do not force the current period by creating a seven-consecutive-shift stretch; distribute work with rest and follow the user's health constraints.

achievement_days.definition: Days until verified trailing-30-day gross income or a binding next-30-day gross run rate is at least JPY 200,000.

rationale.p20: An accepted safe shift mix plus a small verified paid top-up can close the gap within two weekly action cycles.
rationale.p50: Eighteen day-shift equivalents in the 2026-08-16 through 2026-09-15 pay period produce JPY 201,600 base gross; the payslip/cash verification point is expected by 2026-09-25.
rationale.p80: Allows one additional pay-period cycle if sufficient shifts are not accepted in the first cycle.

maintenance_confirmation_days.definition: Two measurements at least 30 days apart are each at least JPY 200,000, with evidence that the following 30 days continue.
maintenance_confirmation_days.rationale: The central case is two consecutive qualifying pay-period measurements, verified around 2026-09-25 and 2026-10-25.

priority_paths.action: Use the normal weekly availability submission to sustain 18 safe day-shift equivalents per pay period, or an equivalent higher-paid shift mix.
priority_paths.dependency: Employer acceptance and user physical availability.

priority_paths.path: paid AI and social-media support work
priority_paths.role: Close a 43,200-yen base-wage gap or provide resilience if employment shifts are unavailable.
priority_paths.dependency: Application and contract acceptance require the user.

priority_paths.role: Optional upside, not the critical path until traffic or conversion evidence appears.

steps: In the normal weekly shift form, request only a physically safe 4–5-shift week when feasible; never add shifts solely to create an unsafe consecutive run.
In the same session, read only the latest payslip gross-pay amount and return that number plus whether the shift request was submitted; do not send screenshots or personal identifiers.
minimum_user_operation.fallback_signal: If 4–5 shifts are not physically feasible, return only '18勤務不可' so the next run pivots to the paid-work backup.

largest_uncertainties: Latest payslip gross amount and allowances
Acceptance and payment timing of the backup paid work
privacy: No employer name, person name, address, email, phone, account identifier, or secret is stored.
